name: Fred again..
bio: London producer, songwriter, multi-instrumentalist and DJ. Before going solo he was one of pop's busiest producers behind the scenes, then built his own sound out of voice memos, phone videos and found audio in the Actual Life series.
story: At 16 he joined an a cappella group that met at Brian Eno's home, invited by a family friend. Eno became his mentor, and years later they made a whole album together (Secret Life).
awards: Grammy 2024: Best Dance/Electronic Recording (Rumble, with Skrillex & Flowdan)
